basic_info.description: Here is Arturo! I'm a Software developer and Data analyst, this page exists now to show my portfolio! If you see something interesting, let's chat!

projects.title: Animal Shelter
projects.description: The most expanded application I had opportunity to work with. I've learned many technologies and my code was reviewed by awesome curator. Application handles all adoption processess and allows to store all evidence on adopting animals from animal shelter.

projects.title: Photography
projects.description: Personal project for study subject. I was responsible for testing a photography application that optimizes images with popular algorithms used by graphic editors like Pixlr or Adobe Photoshop. I've earned A grade :)

projects.title: 3D Object Viewer
projects.description: One of the first apps I worked on during my internship. I developed the front-end implementation for an app that displays 3D models of known buildings. I've learned a lot!
